a letter for you

written especially for tonight

Happy birthday to the most beautiful person I’ve met this year.

Happy birthday to the sweetest heart I’ve ever had the chance to know.

I honestly don’t have the words to describe how much I love you or how grateful I am to have you in my life. You have no idea how crazy my heart beats whenever I see you typing, or how deeply I’ve fallen for you in a way you probably can’t even imagine.

I know we haven’t known each other for very long, but you’ve already shown me that love isn’t about how much time you’ve spent with someone. It’s about the way they make you feel, and the genuine feelings they bring into your life.

You’re genuinely the most amazing girl, and I could never put into words just how incredible you are. Every time I see you or hear you talk, I somehow find myself falling for you even more. You’re just so unbelievably captivating.

I hope this year is kind to you and brings you everything you’ve ever wished for. You deserve every beautiful thing in this world, especially with a heart as amazing as yours.

Thank you for becoming one of the best parts of my life. I don’t care how much time has passed or how much time will pass. I just want you to know that I’ll always love you more than I did yesterday and less than I will tomorrow.

I love you so, so, so much.

Happy birthday, sweetheart.
— Forever yours ♡
